title: Mains study breakdown — Papers III and IV
notice: Derived study guidance. Every unit below groups or subdivides official syllabus lines; it never adds a requirement of its own.

mains/paper-III.focus: Economics with a substantial Madhya Pradesh half, plus science, technology and public health. Part B is the most scheme-heavy part of the whole examination.

mains/paper-III/part-a/unit-1.focus: The longest unit in the paper. It moves through the economy's shape, agriculture, industry and infrastructure in one sweep.

units.title: Features of the economy and the 2047 vision
units.note: The 2047 vision is a named policy goal and needs its own notes rather than a passing mention.

units.title: Sectoral contribution and national income
match: कृषि, उद्योग और सेवा क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रीय योगदान
units.note: Keep GDP, GNP, NNP and the related measures distinct.

units.title: Agriculture: crops, distress and price policy
match: कृषि मूल्य नीति, विपणन और वित्त
units.note: Declining productivity, farmer distress and weather dependence are the three challenges the source names.

units.title: Government agricultural initiatives
units.note: PM-KISAN and NMSA are named; learn the scheme, its ministry and its intended beneficiary.

units.title: Agri start-ups and value addition
units.note: Links to the food-processing heading in Mains Paper I Part B Unit III.

units.title: Industrial policy, manufacturing and infrastructure
match: विनिर्माण और अधोसंरचना- मेक इन इंडिया
units.note: Make in India and infrastructure projects are named; keep the policy and the project separate.

units.title: Hospitality, tourism and standardisation
match: भारत में वस्तु व सेवाओं का मानकीकरण
units.note: Foreign-exchange earnings is the specific angle for tourism, and standardisation covers BIS-style quality frameworks.

mains/paper-III/part-a/unit-2.focus: Taxation, fiscal and monetary policy, and India's external economic relations.

units.title: Fiscal policy
units.note: Expenditure, revenue and deficit management are listed as three parts of one line.

units.title: Monetary policy and financial inclusion
match: मौद्रिक नीति और भारत में वित्तीय समावेशन
units.note: Keep the policy instruments separate from the inclusion schemes.

units.title: Cash transactions and the informal economy
units.note: A narrower, analytically interesting heading — prepare the demonetisation-style debates.

units.title: Food security and the public distribution system
match: खाद्य सुरक्षा एवं लोक वितरण प्रणाली
units.note: Overlaps the storage and distribution heading in Unit III of this same part.

units.title: Poverty, unemployment and regional imbalance
units.note: Three social-economic problems grouped in one line; measurements and schemes for each.

units.title: Foreign trade
units.note: Value, composition and direction is the standard three-part answer structure.

units.title: Export promotion, import substitution and foreign capital
units.note: Prepare the arguments on both sides of import substitution.

units.title: International financial institutions
units.note: Four institutions named — mandate, membership and India's relationship with each.

mains/paper-III/part-a/unit-3.focus: A full overview of Madhya Pradesh's economy, sector by sector.

units.title: Growth, self-reliance and ODOP
split: राज्य घरेलू उत्पाद और प्रति व्यक्ति आय में वृद्धि
units.note: Two named state programmes sit in this one line; ODOP district-product mapping is high yield.

units.title: Crops, cropping patterns and holdings
match: प्रमुख फसलें और फसल पैटर्न तथा जोत
units.note: Holding size is a distinct element — include land-holding data.

units.title: Food security, distribution and storage
match: खाद्य सुरक्षा, वितरण प्रणाली और भंडारण
units.note: Storage and warehousing are specific to the state here.

units.title: Horticulture, livestock, dairy and fisheries
units.note: Four allied sectors in one line, each capable of its own question.

units.title: Industry and infrastructure
units.note: Current status plus infrastructure development.

units.title: MSME and traditional industries
units.note: The support-and-development angle rather than the sector's size alone.

units.title: Rural and urban development, and the tribal economy
match: मध्यप्रदेश में ग्रामीण एवं शहरी विकास
units.note: The tribal economy is named inside this heading and is a recurring state theme.

units.title: Tourism, trade and investment promotion
units.note: State investment policy and the tourism circuit are the examinable parts.

mains/paper-III/part-a/unit-4.focus: Social and economic development in Madhya Pradesh, including the state's fiscal position.

units.title: Health, education and skills
match: स्वास्थ्य अधोसंरचना, शिक्षा और कौशल विकास
units.note: Same three headings as the state human-resources item in Prelims Paper I subject 6, at greater depth.

units.title: Natural resource management policy
match: प्राकृतिक संसाधन प्रबंधन के लिए नीतियाँ-
units.note: Three resources, three policies — do not merge them into one answer.

units.title: Inclusion and welfare schemes
match: वित्तीय, सामाजिक समावेशन एवं कल्याणकारी योजनाएँ
units.note: Scheme plus beneficiary group plus current status.

units.title: Demographic influence
units.note: The angle is the effect of demography on development, not the numbers alone.

units.title: Human resource productivity and employment
match: मानव संसाधन की उत्पादकता और रोजगार
units.note: Productivity and employment together; employability data helps.

units.title: Intellectual property rights in the state
match: मध्यप्रदेश में बौद्धिक सम्पदा अधिकारों की प्रगति
units.note: Third appearance of this heading across the syllabus; one set of notes covers all three.

units.title: State finances
units.note: Fiscal discipline is named explicitly — prepare the state's deficit and debt position.

mains/paper-III/part-a/unit-5.focus: Statistics and data analysis. This is a methods unit, so it is learned by working through calculations rather than by reading.

units.title: Data collection
units.note: Primary and secondary methods, with their limitations.

units.title: Averages
units.note: The syllabus asks for both calculation and interpretation — practise both.

units.title: Types of data analysis
units.note: Descriptive versus inferential is an explicit comparison.

units.title: Sampling methods
units.note: Know which design suits which kind of study.

units.title: Data presentation
units.note: Tables, charts and graphs — the same skills as Prelims Paper II numeracy.

units.title: Basic probability
units.note: Foundational concepts rather than advanced probability.

mains/paper-III/part-b/unit-1.focus: General science from microorganisms to astronomy, with biotechnology and patents at the end.

units.title: Applications of science
units.note: Everyday applications rather than theory.

units.title: Microorganisms and organic farming
units.note: Microorganism types and organic farming are paired in one line.

units.title: Cell and classification
units.note: Cell biology and taxonomy in one heading.

units.title: Nutrition, diet and the human body
match: पौधों, पशुओं एवं मनुष्यों में पोषण
split: मानव शरीर के अंग, संरचना एवं कार्य-प्रणाली
units.note: Vitamin-deficiency disease pairing is the highest-yield part.

units.title: Biotechnology and ethnobiology
units.note: Biotechnology is asked sector-wise — health, agriculture, horticulture, animal husbandry, industry and environment.

units.title: Ancient Indian astronomy
units.note: Name-and-contribution recall, plus the observatories.

units.title: Patents and intellectual property
match: बौद्धिक संपदा के अधिकार एवं पेटेंट
units.note: TRIPS and TRIMS are named; keep the two agreements distinct.

mains/paper-III/part-b/unit-2.focus: Computer science, with a mathematical-science block attached to it.

units.title: Types and generations of computers
match: कंप्यूटर के प्रकार, विशेषताएँ एवं पीढ़ी
units.note: Generation-by-generation characteristics.

units.title: Hardware, software and operating systems
split: मेमोरी, इनपुट और आउटपुट डिवाइसेस, स्टोरेज डिवाइस
units.note: This heading is a long list of device types — treat it as a checklist.

units.title: Programming languages and translators
match: कंप्यूटर की भाषाओं का सामान्य ज्ञान
units.note: The distinction between compiler, interpreter and assembler is the standard question.

units.title: Internet, e-mail and social media
units.note: Short headings, but they connect to cyber security and current affairs.

units.title: E-governance
units.note: Third appearance across the syllabus after Prelims Paper I subject 9 and this part's own digital themes.

units.title: AI, cloud computing and web resources
split: विभिन्न उपयोगी पोर्टल और वेबसाइट तथा वेबपेजेस
units.note: Portals worth knowing are the state and national service portals.

units.title: Mathematical science
split: संख्याएँ एवं इसके प्रकार इकाई मापन की विधियाँ
ज्यामितीय आकृतियों का क्षेत्रफल एवं पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल
units.note: A sub-block inside Computer Science in the source itself. These are arithmetic and mensuration skills — practise them numerically.

mains/paper-III/part-b/unit-3.focus: AYUSH systems and their scientific basis, plus health administration.

units.title: The AYUSH systems
split: होम्योपैथी चिकित्सा पद्धतियों के मूल सिद्धांत
units.note: Five systems; each needs its founding principles, not just its name.

units.title: One Nation One Health System
units.note: A named national policy to 2030 — prepare its objective and scope.

units.title: Ayurveda
units.note: Tridosh and Panchamahabhut are the conceptual core; the daily and seasonal routines are practical additions.

units.title: Health administration and the national health policy
match: केन्द्र, राज्य, जिला एवं ग्राम स्तर पर आयुष
split: केन्द्र, राज्य, जिला एवं ग्राम स्तर पर आयुष सहित स्वास्थ्य प्रशासन
units.note: Administrative structure at four levels plus the policy and Ayurveda's place in it.

units.title: Yoga and naturopathy
split: मिट्टी चिकित्सा, धूप सेवन (Sun Bath), जल चिकित्सा
units.note: Named techniques with their therapeutic effects.

units.title: Shodasha sanskar
units.note: The scientific significance is explicitly part of the heading.

mains/paper-III/part-b/unit-4.focus: National health programmes and primary health care.

units.title: National health programmes, named by abbreviation
units.note: The source prints each programme with its abbreviation. Learn full form, launch and target for all ten.

units.title: Missions and state health indicators
match: स्वच्छ भारत मिशन, आयुष्मान भारत योजना
split: स्वच्छ भारत मिशन, आयुष्मान भारत योजना
units.note: The maternal mortality rate of Madhya Pradesh is an explicitly state-specific item.

units.title: Biomarkers
units.note: Normal ranges are asked, so keep a reference table.

units.title: Primary health care structure
split: उपकेन्द्र एवं ग्राम स्तर पर प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल की संरचना
प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल केन्द्र (PHC), सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य केन्द्र (CHC)
units.note: Draw the referral pyramid from sub-centre through PHC and CHC to rural hospitals.

mains/paper-III/part-b/unit-5.focus: Environment in Indian tradition, environmental problems, education, technology and conservation.

units.title: Environment in Indian tradition
match: भारतीय परंपरा और संस्कृति में पर्यावरण
split: भारतीय परंपरा और संस्कृति में पर्यावरण की अवधारणा
जनपदोध्वंस- वायु, जल, देश, काल की विकृतियाँ
units.note: Janapadodhvans is an Ayurvedic concept of collective environmental harm — a distinctive term worth learning precisely.

units.title: Human impact, biodiversity and species loss
match: मानव गतिविधियों का पर्यावरण पर प्रभाव
split: पर्यावरण से संबंधित नैतिकता और मूल्य
जैव-विविधता (विशेष रूप से मध्यप्रदेश के संदर्भ में)
units.note: Biodiversity is to be studied with special reference to Madhya Pradesh.

units.title: Environmental problems and degradation
match: पर्यावरण से संबंधित समस्याएँ और चुनौतियाँ
units.note: Cause and effect are separated in the source.

units.title: Environmental education and awareness
split: पर्यावरण शिक्षा एवं उसका स्वास्थ्य एवं सुरक्षा से संबंध
units.note: The health-and-safety link is the distinctive part of this heading.

units.title: Environmental technology, law and policy
split: पर्यावरण संरक्षण नीतियाँ और नियामक ढाँचा
units.note: Constitutional provisions and the regulatory framework are separately examinable.

units.title: Tribes and conservation
match: पर्यावरण संरक्षण में मध्यप्रदेश की जनजातियों
units.note: Five communities are named — Baiga, Sahariya, Bhariya, Bhil and Gond.

units.title: Solid waste management
split: नगरीय और औद्योगिक अपशिष्ट के कारण, प्रभाव
units.note: Urban and industrial waste separately, with control measures.

units.title: Cleanliness survey campaign
units.note: Objective, stages, achievements and future — a four-part structure given by the syllabus itself.

units.title: Water security and conservation
match: जल संरक्षण के क्षेत्र में किए जाने वाले विभिन्न प्रयास
units.note: Two short headings; prepare water security as a concept and the conservation efforts as examples.

mains/paper-IV.focus: Philosophy, psychology, public administration and case study, with entrepreneurship and management in Part B. Both parts end with a case study drawn from their own content.

mains/paper-IV/part-a/unit-1.focus: Indian philosophical systems, Western philosophers, and Indian thinkers and reformers.

units.title: Indian Shaddarshan
units.note: The six schools — founder, core text and central doctrine for each.

units.title: Greek philosophers
units.note: Keep each philosopher's central contribution distinct.

units.title: Indian religious and philosophical figures
units.note: Carvaka and Bhartrihari sit at the end of the line and are easy to miss.

units.title: Saints and devotional figures
units.note: Note that Ravidas is named as Sant Ravidas.

units.title: Social reformers, including Madhya Pradesh figures
units.note: Ahilyabai Holkar is the Madhya Pradesh link and recurs in other papers.

units.title: Modern Indian thinkers
split: डॉ. भीमराव आम्बेडकर, पंडित दीनदयाल उपाध्याय
units.note: Ambedkar and Deendayal Upadhyaya appear across papers — keep their thought in one place.

mains/paper-IV/part-a/unit-2.focus: Nation, security and the ethical concepts that sit under them.

units.title: Concept of nation
units.note: Definition and constituent elements.

units.title: National security and interest
units.note: Security, interest and national character are three linked ideas in one line.

units.title: Security apparatus
split: सशस्त्र सैन्य बल, अंग एवं प्रकार
units.note: Armed forces structure plus the intelligence agencies.

units.title: Basic moral concepts
units.note: Four concepts named individually.

units.title: Ethics of the Bhagavad Gita in administration
units.note: The application to administration is the examinable angle, not the text in isolation.

mains/paper-IV/part-a/unit-3.focus: Attitude, aptitude for public service, emotional intelligence, individual differences and psychotherapy.

units.title: Attitude
split: मनोवृत्ति का निर्माण, मनोवृत्ति में परिवर्तन
units.note: Persuasive communication and prejudice are named separately from attitude change itself.

units.title: Aptitude and foundational values for public service
split: समानुभूति, सहिष्णुता एवं कमजोर वर्गों के प्रति संवेदना
units.note: This heading is the values core of the paper — learn each value with an administrative illustration.

units.title: Emotional intelligence
split: शासन-प्रशासन में इसकी उपयोगिता एवं अनुप्रयोग
units.note: Concept plus application in governance.

units.title: Individual differences
units.note: Factors, theories and behavioural differences.

units.title: Mental disorders and psychotherapy
split: तर्क संगत भावनात्मक व्यवहार चिकित्सा, संज्ञानात्मक व्यवहार चिकित्सा
units.note: Five disorders and six therapies are named. Learn the disorder and the therapy it is paired with.

mains/paper-IV/part-a/unit-4.focus: Ethics in public administration and the problem of corruption.

units.title: Human needs, motivation and values
split: मानव व्यक्तित्व को प्रभावित करने वाले विभिन्न तत्त्व
units.note: Technology and moral values are paired in the source — an unusual but examinable combination.

units.title: Ethical virtues in administration
match: लोक प्रशासन में नैतिक सद्गुण एवं मूल्य-
split: शासन में उच्च मूल्यों का पालन
units.note: Integrity, responsibility and transparency are named together; moral dilemma and conscience separately.

units.title: Corruption
split: समाज, सूचनातंत्र, परिवार एवं व्हिसिलब्लोअर की भूमिका
राष्ट्रसंघ की घोषणा, भ्रष्टाचार का मापन, ट्रांसपरेंसी इन्टरनेशनल
units.note: Six strands in one heading. Lokpal and Lokayukta belong here as much as in polity.

mains/paper-IV/part-a/unit-5.focus: A case study built on the content of this part. The syllabus gives no separate reading list for it, so the case material is drawn from Units 1 to 4.

units.title: Case study practice base
units.note: Prepare by working through applied situations drawn from ethics, attitude, emotional intelligence and administrative values — the same ground as the rest of Part A.

mains/paper-IV/part-b/unit-1.focus: Entrepreneurship: concept, process, and its promotion in India.

units.title: Concept and significance
units.note: Definition plus why it matters for employment and growth.

units.title: Characteristics, principles and innovation
units.note: Innovation is called out separately from the traits of an entrepreneur.

units.title: The entrepreneurial process
units.note: Four stages listed in sequence — reproduces well as a flow answer.

units.title: New enterprise management and its statutory requirements
match: नए उद्यम प्रबंधन में मुख्य मुद्दे
split: महिला उद्यमियों के सामने आने वाली चुनौतियाँ
units.note: Statutory requirements make this a practical, registration-and-compliance question.

units.title: Entrepreneurship development in India
split: उद्यमिता विकास को बढ़ावा देने वाले संस्थान
units.note: The institutions promoting entrepreneurship are a named list.

mains/paper-IV/part-b/unit-2.focus: Business organisation and management, from purchasing to branding.

units.title: Business, administration and material management
units.note: The distinction between management and administration is the classic question here.

units.title: Management process and functions
units.note: Nine functions are named. They are a list, so expect a direct question on any of them.

units.title: Time management
units.note: Short heading, practical content.

units.title: Branding, marketing and networking
units.note: Three related but separate concepts.

mains/paper-IV/part-b/unit-3.focus: Administration and management, including stress, pluralism and disaster management.

units.title: Management dimensions in public administration
match: लोक प्रशासन में प्रबंध के महत्वपूर्ण आयाम
units.note: Human resource management is attached to this line.

units.title: Financial management
units.note: Its scope and significance in public administration specifically.

units.title: Stress and conflict management
match: लोक कार्य क्षेत्र में तनाव प्रबंधन
units.note: Techniques are what the syllabus asks for, not definitions.

units.title: Managing plurality
split: जन प्रबंधन के अवसर एवं चुनौतियाँ
units.note: Opportunities and challenges are named — prepare both sides.

units.title: Disaster management
units.note: Connects to the disaster content in Mains Paper I Part B Unit IV and Prelims Paper I subject 7.

mains/paper-IV/part-b/unit-4.focus: Personality development, success and failure, programme implementation and a named set of social issues.

units.title: Personality and national development
units.note: Individual development is linked to national development in the syllabus itself.

units.title: Components of personality development
units.note: A list heading — prepare the components and how each is developed.

units.title: Success, its impediments and its causes
units.note: Three consecutive short headings — concept, obstacles and causes. Study them together.

units.title: Learning from failure
units.note: The source states the attitude it wants: failure as insight and as an opportunity for improvement.

units.title: Implementing government programmes
units.note: Effective implementation strategy is the examinable core.

units.title: Facts and approaches on named social issues
match: निम्नांकित मुद्दों से संबंधित तथ्य और दृष्टिकोण
split: नागरिक बोध, संस्था के प्रति निष्ठा
नशाखोरी की प्रवृत्ति, खाद्य पदार्थों में मिलावट
units.note: Eight issues are named in one line. Each needs facts and a reasoned viewpoint, so prepare concrete material rather than opinions.

mains/paper-IV/part-b/unit-5.focus: A case study built on the content of Part B, drawn from entrepreneurship, management, administration and personality development.

units.title: Case study practice base
units.note: Prepare applied situations from the four units of this part — entrepreneurship, management, administrative ethics and personality development.
